metadata.name: LightLog Phase 3 Compositional Semantics Holdout Corpus
metadata.purpose: Fresh classification-focused blind holdout for compositional semantics, span containment and close daily-life category boundaries.
metadata.evaluationFocus: Category correctness. expected.content and expected.occurredAtLocal are intentionally null so content extraction and time formatting do not affect correctness.

priorityMeaning.P0: Deterministic compositional daily case; expected to pass after the small compositional refactor.
priorityMeaning.P1: Confusing but still classifiable everyday case; main robustness target.
priorityMeaning.P2: Long-tail edge case; should not produce a confident wrong category.

blindUse: Keep this file outside the repository until the compositional matcher, span resolver and knowledge changes are frozen.
Do not grep/search/open/parse individual cases before the first evaluation.
After the first run this corpus becomes regression data and must no longer be called unseen.
Do not hard-code exact case strings.
